wave.palette_name: Dungeon Matcher muted silver-violet stone/metal with tiny amethyst jewel accents
wave.description: ONE blank WAVE COUNTER FRAME for Dungeon Matcher, isolated front-facing native pixel-art UI asset. A wide low horizontal plaque about 112px wide and 32px tall centered in the 128x64 canvas, with a small hanging stone skull pendant below its bottom center, making the complete silhouette no taller than 48px. Completely EMPTY dark charcoal-purple interior, broad enough for runtime text WAVE 999; do NOT draw ANY text or letters. Crisp silver-violet metal rim with simple chunky sculpted corner brackets, tiny amethyst rivets and subtle paired scroll-ended side caps. Straight horizontal rails and square 90-degree corners, restrained medieval dungeon craftsmanship, not elaborate baroque curls. Skull pendant about 12px wide, understated stone silhouette with two dark eyes; separate visual ornament below rim, not in text area. Top-left highlights, dark outline, 2-3 useful material tones, broad quiet surfaces. Strong mobile readability and clear pixel grid, no gradients, no blur, no AA, no noisy cracks, no chains, no scenery, no characters, no glowing halo, no painted rendering. All edges fully inside canvas with transparent clearance. Designed to cut into reusable fixed side caps and a repeatable straight rail, not a stretched illustration.

controls.palette_name: Dungeon Matcher muted silver-violet stone/metal with tiny amethyst jewel accents
controls.description: One empty square UI button frame for a whimsical gothic pixel-art dungeon mobile game. Transparent 64x64 canvas, a centered complete 43x43-pixel SQUARE frame, transparent outer margin. Constructed of chunky muted silver-lavender metal with four clean 9x9 square corner blocks, one small warm brass rivet in each corner, straight double-ridge rails 5 pixels thick, a dark violet empty inset. The square blocks and pipe-like rails must share exactly the same centerline. Strong dark contour, top-left highlight, restrained two-tone shadow, no fuzzy light, no texture noise. Flat front view, perfectly upright, symmetrical geometry, no perspective. No lettering, icons, chains, skulls, scenery or gems inside. The reusable square corners and straight rails will be separated to make GUIDE, SETTINGS, and consumable frames of different sizes. Clear quiet dark center for existing runtime labels/icons. Match the reference's disciplined chunky pixel clusters and contrast; no illustration or character.

resonance.palette_name: Dungeon Matcher muted silver-violet stone/metal with tiny amethyst jewel accents
resonance.description: One premium horizontal RESONANCE ability panel FRAME, front view pixel-art game UI, transparent 128x64 canvas. Frame about116x42 centered. Broad dark empty inset approximately100x26 for an existing crowned skull ability icon. Silver-lavender dungeon metal with double straight rails and chunky square corner sockets, small gold rivets, subtle paired pointed violet side brackets. A tiny AMETHYST lozenge at the midpoint of each short side; keep straight central top and bottom rail spans for modular repetition. Strong dark contour and simple top-left highlights, crisp chunky clean pixels, very restrained surface detail. No blur, no glow, no noisy scratches or fragmented pixels. Do NOT draw text, skulls, icons, lightning or character faces INSIDE the panel. Do not draw scenery. Readable at native scale, empty inset not a painted illustration. It will be cut into reusable corners/rails/inset to adapt to different widths, not resized. Transparent margin around all four edges.
